gloss: free-spirited; selfish; doing as one pleases

definitions.gloss: free-spirited, doing as one pleases, easygoing
definitions.explanation: Acting according to one's own wishes and whims without worrying about others' expectations or schedules. Can be positive (carefree) or negative (selfish), depending on context.

examples.japanese: {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしは{気|き}ままでいい。
examples.english: Living alone is nice because you can do as you please.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}は{気|き}ままな{動物|どうぶつ}だとよく{言|い}われる。
examples.english: Cats are often said to be free-spirited animals.

notes:
Na-adjective: {気|き}ままな + noun (modifier), {気|き}ままに + verb (adverbial).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気|き}ままな{暮|く}らし: a carefree lifestyle
- {気|き}ままに{過|す}ごす: to spend time as one pleases
- {気|き}ままな{旅|たび}: an unplanned/freewheeling trip
- {気|き}ままな{性格|せいかく}: a free-spirited personality

NUANCE: When describing oneself or a positive situation (travel, living alone), {気|き}まま has a positive nuance of freedom and ease. When describing someone else's behavior, it can imply selfishness or inconsiderateness — doing whatever one wants without regard for others.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- わがまま: selfish, willful (more negative)
- {自由|じゆう}: free, liberal (more neutral/positive)
- マイペース: at one's own pace
